common.app_name.description: Application name shown in launcher, top bar and about screen. Brand name in Devanagari.

common.action.save.description: Generic confirm/save button label used on all forms.

common.action.cancel.description: Generic dismiss/cancel button label used on all dialogs and forms.

common.action.delete.description: Generic delete action label (soft delete / tombstone in this app).

common.action.edit.description: Generic edit action label on cards and list rows.

common.action.add.description: Generic add action label, used on FABs and empty states.

common.action.close.description: Generic close action for sheets and dialogs.

common.action.retry.description: Retry action after a failed operation (e.g. sync error, network failure).

common.action.share.description: Generic share action label (share sheet trigger).

common.state.offline.description: Short connectivity state label shown next to the cloud status icon.

common.state.synced.description: Sync state label: all local changes have been pushed to the server.

common.state.pending.description: Sync state label: local changes are queued and waiting to sync.

common.state.offline_banner.value: ऑफ़लाइन — बदलाव बाद में सिंक होंगे
common.state.offline_banner.description: Persistent thin banner shown while the device has no connectivity.

common.state.pending_changes.value: {count, plural, one {# बदलाव सिंक होना बाकी} other {# बदलाव सिंक होने बाकी}}
common.state.pending_changes.description: Outbox badge text; count is the number of local operations waiting to sync. ICU plural.

common.nav.booking.description: Bottom navigation tab 1: calendar-first booking management.

common.nav.expenses.description: Bottom navigation tab 2: party ledger for money paid/received.

common.nav.inventory.description: Bottom navigation tab 3: stock items and in/out transactions.

common.nav.menu.description: Bottom navigation tab 4: settings, reports, members, about.

app.placeholder.title.description: Title on placeholder shell screens before the feature is implemented.

app.placeholder.message.description: Body text on placeholder shell screens. {feature} is the localized tab name.

app.feature.onboarding.description: Display name of the onboarding/setup flow, used on its placeholder screen (not a bottom tab).

app.feature.reports.description: Display name of the reports section (lives inside the Menu tab), used on its placeholder screen.

booking.event_type.tilak.description: Built-in event type label (🪔) — pre-wedding tilak ceremony.

booking.event_type.room_booking.description: Built-in event type label (🏨) — guest house / room stay.

booking.event_type.custom.description: Built-in event type label (✨) — user provides free-text label and emoji.

common.language.switcher_label.description: Label / accessible name for the locale switcher control in the app bar and settings.

common.language.en.description: Display name of the English locale, always shown in its own script regardless of current locale.

common.language.hi.description: Display name of the Hindi locale, always shown in its own script regardless of current locale.

auth.sign_in.email_label.description: Label for the email input on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.password_label.description: Label for the password input on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.submit.description: Submit button label on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.google.description: Button label for signing in with a Google account.

auth.sign_in.error.value: साइन इन नहीं हो पाया। अपना ईमेल और पासवर्ड जांचें।
auth.sign_in.error.description: Generic error shown when email+password sign-in is rejected.

auth.sign_in.not_configured.value: साइन इन अभी इस सर्वर पर सेट नहीं है।
auth.sign_in.not_configured.description: Shown when the backend connection settings are missing, so authentication is unavailable.

auth.action.sign_out.description: Sign-out action label in the app shell / menu.
